gen-dafont-redux-gf-huninn: Redux spreads out with generous spacing and a visible swoop into every curve, a geometric display face with a bigger lowercase. Huninn brings crossbars as sturdy as its stems and lowercase that rises nearly to cap height, giving the pair a confident backbone.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-kufi-arabic:
Redux stretches out, each curve entered with a visible swoop.

Noto Kufi Arabic gives it a plain sans partner, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase, so the showy heading never has to compete.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Contemporary geometry drives Redux, with gentle stroke modulation and a lowercase enlarged past the usual. Yet Noto Sans Bassa Vah is the one that fills the line, its dominant midsection and pliers-like c doing the plain, sturdy work.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Redux keeps hairlines that are present but not razor thin, spaced generously and entered with a visible swoop on each curve. And Noto Sans Ethiopic, a plain sans with a tall, sturdy lowercase, would carry a long passage steadily, its c terminals hanging well off the bowl.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Redux lays out wide-spaced letters with a small but steady shift in stroke thickness, plus a swoop into every curve. Gurmukhi's outward tongs feel tidy beside it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Redux has the tempered contrast of a lightly flexed spring wire, spaced wide with a swooping entry into each curve. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian sits beneath it as sans-serif with big open eyes and a deep middle band, so the two read as spacious and steady together.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-kannada: A visible swoop into every curve is what defines Redux, along with its enlarged lowercase and subtle weight gradient along each stroke. And Noto Sans Kannada, a sans-serif with s curves open wide at both ends, relaxes the page into something approachable.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: Redux enters each curve with a visible swoop, spacing its enlarged lowercase wide while the weight shifts gradually instead of snapping. Redux handles showmanship; Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a sans-serif with large lowercase eyes, handles the quiet work.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-multani: Redux spaces its enlarged lowercase generously, with a middling spread between its heaviest and lightest parts and a swoop into each curve. Noto Sans Multani, a plain sans with a lofty x-height, holds the text itself.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Contemporary and spaced out, Redux swoops into every curve. Noto Sans Nushu, a plain sans with a towering x-height and terminals held far from the stroke, gives that flourish a tall, modern companion to lean against.
